summary: Quartzsea Acquisition Corp (SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting entry into a definitive merger agreement to combine with Eight Directions Technology Limited via a two-step SPAC merger and acquisition merger. Under the terms, Parent merges into Purchaser, then Merger Sub merges into the Company, with shareholders receiving Purchaser Class A ordinary shares. No per-share price, consideration, premium, or close date is disclosed, but the structure is a standard de-SPAC business combination. The filing reflects a binding agreement (no tender/preliminary proxy), implying the SPAC aims to finalize and take the target public. Watch for proxy filing, shareholder vote, and any redemption risk.
